column3: (Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: X-Frame-Options DENY is set on every route.)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: nosniff is set on every route.)
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: the session cookie is HttpOnly.)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag: the session cookie is Secure outside development.)
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute: the session cookie is SameSite=Lax.)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: HSTS is set, but responses the spider reads from cache lack headers (see 10050).)
(CSP weaknesses: style-src 'unsafe-inline' is a known trade-off for React inline styles.)
(Cross-Origin Embedder/Opener Policy: COOP is set; COEP would block profile photos from Neon Storage.)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: Vercel sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin * on public static files, which carry no credentials. The API has its own strict CORS.)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: comments in minified third-party bundles.)
